nomic-embed-text:latest.name: Search Index
nomic-embed-text:latest.description: Not a chat model — pull this once to power the Reference Library's semantic search (the 📚 toggle in chat, and the Library tab's search). Tiny and fast; works regardless of whatever chat model you actually talk to.

qwen3.5:4b.name: Core
qwen3.5:4b.description: Same Aug-2026-era generation as the other tiers' picks, and a large step up from Qwen2.5-3B (reported MMLU-Pro 79.1 vs MMLU 65.6). Genuinely tight on a strict 4GB card though — weights alone eat most of the budget, so keep context short (2-4K tokens). If you hit VRAM pressure, drop to Core Lite below instead. Vision claims for this family are unconfirmed on Ollama (see Core+ note in the 8GB file) — treat as text-only

qwen3.5:2b.name: Core Lite
qwen3.5:2b.description: Same generation as Core above, one size down — comfortably fits 4GB with real headroom for context instead of running right up against the limit. The safer default; step up to Core only if you want the extra quality and can live with a short context window

deepseek-r1:1.5b.name: Logic
deepseek-r1:1.5b.description: Smallest genuine chain-of-thought model (Qwen-1.5B distill of R1) — the only real reasoning option that fits 4GB comfortably

moondream:latest.name: Eye
moondream:latest.description: Purpose-built tiny vision model — fast image captioning and simple visual Q&A on minimal VRAM

qwen3-vl:2b.name: Eye Scout
qwen3-vl:2b.description: Newer-gen vision-language model — noticeably better OCR and detail recognition than Moondream for a bit more VRAM

huihui_ai/qwen2.5-abliterate:3b.name: Unchained
huihui_ai/qwen2.5-abliterate:3b.description: Abliterated Qwen2.5-3B — smallest model with refusal behavior fully removed, still coherent at this size

qwen2.5-coder:1.5b.name: Dev
qwen2.5-coder:1.5b.description: Smallest Qwen2.5-Coder release — good for autocomplete and short snippets, not full-file refactors

llama3.2:3b.name: Muse
llama3.2:3b.description: Punches above its weight for creative writing on very limited hardware; natural prose for its size

hf.co/bartowski/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.2-3B-G.name: Ranger
hf.co/bartowski/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.2-3B-G.description: No model is trained specifically on survival literature, but Dolphin's training strips refusal behavior out of the dataset entirely — where a safety-tuned model will hedge or decline on improvised first aid, water purification chemistry, or defensive topics, Dolphin just answers.
